notes: SSC CGL 2025 Tier I (CBE) was conducted between 12-Sep-2025 and 26-Sep-2025 (15 consecutive exam days, Shifts 1-3 each = 45 shifts) with an additional exam day on 14-Oct-2025 (Shift 1) - 46 documented shifts total, per Oliveboard Tier I PYP page shift-wise table (https://www.oliveboard.in/blog/ssc-cgl-tier-1-pyps/, accessed 2026-08-24) (12-Sep corroborated by direct CDN response-sheet PDFs with header times 09:00/12:30/16:00; verified files in this repository). No 4th shift is listed for any date in the Oliveboard table (some sources describe a 4th shift as 'optional'; none documented). Verified files in this repository: 12-Sep Shifts 1-3 (3 of 46).
